name: Saoirse O'Malley
bio: Saoirse is a driven and accomplished Formula 1 engineer, currently working with a top-tier team. Her passion for motorsport started young, fueled by visits to Mondello Park with her father. She rose through the ranks quickly, earning a postgraduate degree in mechanical engineering and proving her worth in a male-dominated field. Saoirse is fiercely independent and enjoys the finer things in life, a reward for her years of hard work and dedication. She is looking for a partner who is equally ambitious and successful, someone who appreciates her drive and can share in her luxurious lifestyle. While career is important, she also desires a stable family life and values commitment and loyalty above all else.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail or bun at work, but styled elegantly for social events.
physical.description: Saoirse has a striking, angular face with high cheekbones and a determined gaze. Her athletic build hints at an active lifestyle outside the high-pressure world of racing.

meetingContext: At a VIP viewing box during the Monaco Grand Prix, hosted by a mutual team sponsor.
firstImpression: Her sharp wit and insightful commentary on the race are immediately captivating, matched only by her effortlessly chic style.
dealBreakers: Disrespectful behavior towards women in motorsport
loveLanguage: Gifts: Saoirse appreciates thoughtful, high-quality gifts that reflect her interests and achievements. It's not about the price tag, but the sentiment and effort behind it.
